title: Promote admitted Real scalars before floating-reference arithmetic
observation: NumPy int64 shifted normalization reverses the extreme-value weights; low-precision dot products overflow even where a Python float result is finite.
cause: Validation admits Real scalar types but vector arithmetic still runs in each caller's wrapping or low-precision scalar implementation.
severity: incorrect arithmetic, state or evidence admission on valid/ambiguous boundary inputs
implemented_change: Copy validated vector entries to Python float before subtraction and products. Keep the separate fixed-point reference unchanged.
predicted_consequence: New constructed regressions fail on the recorded parent and pass after the repair while the existing bounded suite passes.
